name: Garbage Collector
author: fluffy
description: Live, read-only system activity — file and registry I/O, DLL loads, call stacks, network, processes, terminal history — scraped as raw text and used as the raw material for evolving formations: a Midjourney-style vortex, a curl-noise flow field, and rotating 3D objects built from glyphs. Every 5 minutes the scene is killed and rebuilt from a fresh scrape. A digital alarm clock with a pixel hourglass keeps time and never dies. Not music-reactive.

roundSeconds.label: Seconds per formation
roundSeconds.hint: How long each formation holds before the scene is killed and a fresh scrape is poured in. Default 300 = 5 minutes.

formations.label: Formation order
formations.hint: shuffle = cycle randomly through all formations. Or lock the scene to a single one.

density.label: Glyph density
density.hint: Scales how many glyphs each formation uses. Lower it if the GPU is working too hard; the quality governor also trims this automatically.

glyphScale.label: Glyph size
glyphScale.hint: Overall size of the individual characters.

spin.label: Motion speed
spin.hint: How fast the vortex turns, the flow field drifts and the 3D objects rotate. 0 freezes the idle motion.

colorMode.label: Colour by
colorMode.hint: uniform = every glyph uses the base colour below. source = each activity source (file, registry, DLL, stack, net, dns, powershell, history, process) gets its own colour.

baseColor.label: Base glyph colour
baseColor.hint: The colour used for every glyph in 'uniform' mode, and the starting point all source colours default to.

clockScale.label: Clock size
clockScale.hint: Size of the alarm clock + hourglass on each monitor.

clockX.label: Clock horizontal position
clockX.hint: Where the clock sits across each monitor: 0.04 left edge, 0.5 centre, 0.96 right edge.

clockY.label: Clock vertical position
clockY.hint: Where the clock sits down each monitor: 0.1 top, 0.9 bottom.

clockColor.label: Clock colour
clockColor.hint: Colour of the digits and hourglass. Default is a neon grey.

showDate.label: Show day and date
showDate.hint: Second line under the time, e.g. TUE · SEP 28.

redactView.label: Redact secrets on screen
redactView.hint: The collector already masks tokens, passwords and your username before anything reaches the wallpaper. This is a second, display-side pass that blanks anything token-shaped that slips through. Leave on unless you want the raw feed.
